mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event (event_se, category_id, author_id, title, content) VALUES ('ANN', #{categoryId}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, category_id, title, content, views, created_at FROM event WHERE event_se = 'ANN' ORDER BY event_id DESC
SELECT event_id, category_id, title, content, views, created_at FROM event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND event_se = 'ANN' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE event SET category_id = #{request.categoryId}, title = #{request.title}, content = #{request.content} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND event_se = 'ANN'
